summary.oneLiner: A Gujarat-based B2B manufacturer of technical and synthetic yarns — para-aramid, polypropylene, flame-retardant and high-tenacity — spanning the Indutech, Protech, Hometech and Mobiltech technical-textile categories from a single spinning facility at Petlad.
summary.business: Ashutosh Fibre Limited manufactures technical and synthetic yarns and fabrics at its facility in Petlad, Gujarat, using Ring Spun, DREF (Friction Spun) and Open-End spinning technologies across five processing lines, supported by two-for-one twisting and splicing. It operates a business-to-business model, supplying industrial manufacturers, processors and institutional buyers who use the yarns as raw-material inputs in filtration and pollution control, construction and infrastructure, automotive friction materials, packaging, protective equipment and home furnishing.
